what_changed: Inner Mongolia merges into Mongolia. Qinghai and Korea are both still separate.
caption: Inner Mongolia joins Mongolia. Qinghai is still its own country and Korea is still two.
caption_original: Inner Mongolia joins Mongolia. Qinghai is still its own country and Korea is still two.

epoch_summary: Mongolia stands whole again — the first post-war reunification, while Qin and Qinghai and the Koreas remain divided.

what_changed: The two Koreas unify. NEW RENDER — this exact territorial combination (Mongolia merged, Korea merged, Qinghai still its own country) has never been drawn before; it did not exist under the old branch structure.
caption: Korea is one. Qinghai is still its own country. China is still nine states.
caption_original: Korea is one. Qinghai is still its own country. China is still nine states.
sovereign_ids: NCP; NW; QH; BAS; JIN; WU; GAN; XIA; MIN; YUE; MAN; MON; ETK; TIB; TWN; KOR; JPN
epoch_summary: Korea stands whole again — the second reunification.

what_changed: Qinghai merges into Qin — the last of the three bilateral mergers. Everything except the Federation itself is now unified.
caption: Qinghai joins Qin. Korea is one and Mongolia is one. China is still nine states.
caption_original: Qinghai joins the Northwest. Korea is one and Mongolia is one. China is still nine states.
sovereign_ids: NCP; NW; BAS; JIN; WU; GAN; XIA; MIN; YUE; MAN; MON; ETK; TIB; TWN; KOR; JPN
epoch_summary: Every bilateral division is resolved — Qinghai has joined Qin.

what_changed: The nine Han states unify into the Sinian Federation. Korea and Mongolia are already one.
caption: The nine Han states unify into the Sinian Federation. Korea and Mongolia are already one. Jeju-do is ordinary Korean territory; the International Court of Diplomacy has not yet been founded.
caption_original: Both unions complete. Jeju-do is ordinary Korean territory; the International Court of Diplomacy has not yet been founded.
sovereign_ids: SIN; MAN; MON; ETK; TIB; TWN; KOR; JPN
epoch_summary: The Sinian Federation stands united — East Asia's post-war consolidation is complete, eight sovereign powers remain.

map_title: ASIA (EAST) — Neutral Jeju-Do and the Court
what_changed: Jeju-do detaches from Korea and becomes neutral ground shared by Korea, Japan and the Sinian Federation. The count is 8 NATIONS plus 1 CONDOMINIUM - Jeju is not a nation and gets its own legend class
caption: Jeju-do is neutral ground, submitted by Korea and legally shared with Japan and the Sinian Federation.
caption_original: Jeju-do is neutral ground, submitted by Korea and legally shared with Japan and the Sinian Federation. No dates are implied.
sovereign_ids: SIN; MAN; MON; ETK; TIB; TWN; KOR; JPN; JEJ
epoch_summary: Establishment of the International Court of Diplomacy at Jeju-Do — neutral ground shared by three powers, submitted by Korea under carefully negotiated stipulations.
